about: Settings for every guide video. Change a number here and run make again (add --no-record to reuse the recording). Levels are plain gains: 1 = as loud as the source after the kit evens it out.

voice.about: The AI voice: OpenMontage's Piper tool (free, offline) through tools/voice-line.py. Swap model for hi_IN-pratham-medium or hi_IN-rohan-medium (male). speed: higher is slower.

music.about: One track under every video (owner picked Indian Wedding on 2026-11-15, after the first renders). level: when nobody speaks. underVoice: while a line plays. startAt: seconds into the track to begin.

video.about: bitrate keeps files light for WhatsApp and the website (about 3 Mbps, like the launch film).

zoom.about: Gentle zoom on each tapped element: small targets get up to max, big ones get min. 1 = no zoom.

captions.about: Caption size in pixels for each size of video.
